IMPLEMENTED SCOPE
The previous batch path accepted an effect as a new original, causing successive
preset application to stack processing. processingOriginalFor now resolves the
verified root original first, using visited identities and a 64-hop bound. Missing
or damaged source links, cycles or excess depth fail closed. Existing sourceFor
retains immediate-input semantics for hold-original comparison of old effects.
Shared Batch normalizes inputs before rendering. The original and its effects
are merged by root content plus chosen preset/model; derive and publication occur
once for the same result. Applying A to effect A reuses the verified existing A;
selecting B generates B from the root original. Gallery publication failures can
retry and deleted targets can regenerate while the original remains valid.
New reused/merged state drives existing-result/reuse/merge feedback. Confirmation
explains that effects start from the original and identical work is not duplicated.
Originals remain unchanged; this adds no new rendering algorithm or camera write.
